json.title: Gangtok Pink Dawn
json.logline: A family winter road trip to Gangtok reaches its peak as the morning sun paints the snowy mountains pink.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Single felt piano note echoing over quiet dark morning mist
Balcony door opens as warmth expands into the frame
String swell begins as steam rises from brass tumbler
Analogue pad rises as golden light hits peak edge
Full arpeggio drop as Kanchenjunga illuminates in rose pink
Layered memory collage with warm glowing textures
Final piano note decays into soft mountain warmth

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle creep toward the car window frame
scenes.action: A young man with short dark curly hair and glasses exhales a visible breath against a frosty car window.
scenes.setting: Inside a vintage car along a dark winding Himalayan road in winter dawn.

scenes.camera_note: Horizontal drift revealing the vast mountain landscape behind balcony
scenes.action: The young man wearing a heavy wool sweater steps out onto a frost-dusted wooden hotel balcony.
scenes.setting: Wooden hotel balcony overlooking deep blue-violet mountain shadows in misty Gangtok.

scenes.camera_note: Slow upward tilt following rising steam into distant sky
scenes.action: Steam drifts upward from a hot brass tea tumbler placed on the frost-dusted wooden ledge.
scenes.setting: Wooden balcony ledge overlooking a vast distant valley.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid emotional push towards face as light changes
scenes.action: The young man tilts his face towards the sky as first pink light catches his rectangular glasses.
scenes.setting: Hotel balcony edge bathed in early rosy alpine light.

scenes.camera_note: Wide sweeping pull back to reveal grand panorama in full golden-rose brilliance
scenes.action: Majestic snow-capped Kanchenjunga mountain peaks turn brilliant rose-pink under the morning sun.
scenes.setting: Panoramic Gangtok horizon filled with glowing snow peaks and warm amber light.

scenes.camera_note: Dreamy multi-layer drift across painterly textures
scenes.action: The young man stands leaning on the balcony with warm golden-pink sunlight illuminated across his jacket.
scenes.setting: Sun-bathed Himalayan hotel terrace surrounded by pine trees and distant misty hills.

scenes.camera_note: Gentle backward drift letting the frame breathe out
scenes.action: The young man smiles softly with closed eyes as gentle morning light envelops his face.
scenes.setting: Sunlit balcony frame fading into soft milky cream highlights.
